placeName.zh-CN: 瑞士奥西耶尔至法国霞慕尼

courseChanges.from: 旧版页面未单列的最高点
courseChanges.to: Tête de Balme 2,321 m（2026 新增）

note.zh-CN: 官方 2026 页面写明 Tête de Balme（2,321 m）为本届新增最高点；赛道因此两次穿越法瑞边界。
note.en: The official 2026 page states that Tête de Balme (2,321 m) is the new high point and that the course crosses the French-Swiss border twice.

details.direction: Orsières (CH) → Champex-Lac → Trient → Col de Balme → Tête de Balme → Swiss side → Vallorcine (FR) → Col des Posettes → Chamonix (FR)
details.distanceMethod: Official 2026 OCC course-profile block and timing table: 61.4 km. The same page's stat block says 60 km. This card uses the 61.4 km table total; the page shows both figures and they are not averaged.
details.elevationMethod: Official 2026 OCC course-profile block and timing table: 3,342 m of positive gain and 3,222 m of negative gain. The same page's stat block says 3,500 m. This card uses the 3,342 m table total; the page shows both figures and they are not averaged.
details.attribution: UTMB Mont-Blanc / UTMB World Series. The organiser page exposes a direct GPX (OCC 2026, 831,287 bytes). The file was downloaded once to a temporary directory and measured locally (5,118 points, 60.14 km planar, +3,342 / −3,221 m at a 3 m threshold, 893–2,311 m), then deleted. The GPX sits between the official 60 km header and 61.4 km timing table; it is linked as official geometry but not treated as a replacement for either official figure. The file carries a LiveTrail copyright line and no redistribution licence; no track is mirrored, hosted or redrawn.
